facts.fact: 她用低沉平静的声音叫 Caleb，这声音与她心里的感觉正相反，接着问他「你在干什么」。
facts.anchor: in a low, calm voice that’s the exact opposite of how I feel

facts.fact: 那把枪全黑，装的是子弹而不是针剂；他握枪的样子像以前握过枪。
facts.anchor: The gun is all black—loaded with bullets, not needles—and he holds it like he’s held one before.

facts.fact: 在她脑子里，这像有人拉响了火警。
facts.anchor: It’s as if he set off a fire alarm in my mind.

facts.fact: 他不发抖，不像那个在 Abnegation 总部旁小巷差点杀死她的男孩。
facts.anchor: He’s not trembling, like that boy who almost killed me in the alley next to Abnegation headquarters.

facts.fact: 她慢慢弯下腰把自己的枪放在地上，然后退后一步。
facts.anchor: I bend down slowly and set my gun on the ground. I take a step back.

facts.fact: Caleb 说他为了救父亲的命跟 Jeanine 做了交易，并且打算守自己那一头。
facts.anchor: But I made a deal with Jeanine to save our father’s life, and I intend to keep my end of it.

facts.fact: 他把枪管抵进 Tobias 的头骨。
facts.anchor: He pushes the barrel of the gun into Tobias’s skull.

facts.fact: 她想起自己去 Erudite 总部看他时，他没有帮她。
facts.anchor: When I went to visit him in Erudite headquarters, he didn’t try to help me.
